card.name: Verb after a risk-topic subject
card.fires_on: The linking verb (is, were) right after a subject noun such as "Suicide" or "food allergies", where the sentence goes on to describe a risk or rising prevalence.

modes.label: Suicide is a known risk
modes.description: The verb "is" right after "Suicide" in an antidepressant warning about depression.
modes.example: this risk may persist until significant remission occurs. Suicide<< is>> a known risk of depression and certain other

modes.label: Allergies were more prevalent
modes.description: The verb "were" after "food allergies" in a news report about rising rates.
modes.example: provided support for the theory that food allergies<< were>> more prevalent than in the past due to

card.writes: It promotes words meaning increase or rising, so the model expects a rise or growth to be stated next.
card.plain: It fires on the verb after a health-risk subject, when the sentence is about to say something is growing or more common.
